newsitem.title: USA: Anangel-American rates have leveled off.
newsitem.headline: Anangel-American rates have leveled off.

text.p: Anangel-American Shipholdings Ltd said Monday dry cargo rates have leveled off after a short period of recovery.

The company reported a 72 percent drop in first half, ended Decmeber 31, net income to $2,961,000, or $0.19 per share, saying this reflected the deterioration in dry cargo freight rates which started in September 1995 and lasted until October 1996.
The subsequent improvement in the freight markets now appears to have leveled off, Anangel-American said in a statement released in New York.

However, it continued, the freight market levels during this short period of recovery, when some of the company's vessels were renewed, were lower than those of the expiring charters, especially on the larger vessels.
